services.desc: Cruisin Tikis – Mission Bay’s Floating Party Island Discover the ultimate waterfront hangout aboard our 10-passenger Cruisin Tikis boat. This floating Tiki lounge offers all the vibes of being in your own personal cabana but out on the serene waters of Mission Bay. Guests can relax to their favorite music, keep drinks chilled in the onboard cooler, and soak in the laid-back atmosphere that makes Mission Bay so

includes: Cushioned seating and swim ladder on tiki boat

blurb: Guests rent single or tandem kayaks, stand-up paddleboards, and various boats including a 10-passenger tiki boat to explore Mission Bay. Rentals are self-operated, allowing guests to enjoy the water at their own pace. The tiki boat features cushioned seating, a swim ladder, and a Bluetooth sound system for a social cruising experience.
